verdict.rationale: Unleash's Admin API gives comprehensive programmatic access to flags/configs (unleash-docs-6) and impact-metrics can automate rollout pause/progression based on thresholds (unleash-docs-14, unleash-docs-22, unleash-docs-29), which could feed an agent's analysis. However, the documented MCP server is scoped to creating/managing feature flags, not reading experiment results or generating ship/rollback recommendations (unleash-docs-7), and no evidence shows an API/interface specifically for experiment result summarization or automated recommendation output. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP support for querying experiment results/analytics, and any documented recommendation-generation workflow for agents.
